title: IT Executive - Application Support Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position Title: IT Executive – Application Support Engineer**

**Work LocationTirupur**

**Qualification: B.Sc. / B.E. Computer Science**

**Experience: 3-5 Years**

**Mode: 6 days per Week | WFO**

**EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**

* **The Executive – Application Support Engineer is a critical technical role responsible for delivering comprehensive end-to-end support for mission-critical enterprise applications supporting supply chain, sourcing and vendor portal.**
* This position bridges technical infrastructure and business operations, ensuring seamless application performance, rapid issue resolution, and continuous system optimization across the Enes Textile Mills division.
* The incumbent manages application support, API integrations, user training, and collaborative testing initiatives while maintaining the highest standards of system reliability and data integrity.

**JOB PURPOSE & CORE OBJECTIVES**

Primary PurposeTo provide comprehensive technical and functional support for critical enterprise applications ensuring uninterrupted operations, rapid issue resolution, and continuous system optimization across Enes Textile Mills. The role encompasses application support, API integration management, workflow configuration, testing coordination, and end-user enablement.

**Core Objectives**

* Maintain optimal application health and system availability (≥99.5% uptime) for software applications
* Ensure rapid diagnosis and resolution of application issues with SLA compliance (≥95% ticket closure within agreed timeframes)
* Support business transformation through UAT coordination, user training, and implementation of new functionalities and process improvements

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Application Support & System Monitoring**

* Monitor application health and system performance using monitoring tools
* Respond to and resolve end-user queries and tickets with comprehensive end-to-end technical support
* Monitor background job execution, scheduled tasks, and Hangfire job queues for failures and performance issues
* Escalate and manage high-priority and critical incidents to minimize business disruption and ensure rapid resolution

**Server & Deployment Management**

* Deploy application releases and hotfixes in coordination with development and testing teams
* Maintain and update executable files and verify version control during deployment cycles
* Collaborate with sprint-release teams for validation, testing, and coordinated feature deployment

**Workflow & Configuration Management**

* Administer and maintain approval workflow systems ensuring accurate hierarchical approvals
* Configure new approval workflows and implement changes

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct smoke testing to validate core system functionalities post-deployment
* Diagnose and analyse technical issues to identify root causes and implement permanent resolutions
* Track, document, and follow up on bugs, enhancements, and system improvement items Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

**Business Requirements & User Enablement**

* Gather and document new business requirements and coordinate implementation with development teams
* Communicate effectively with end users to understand requirements and deliver accurate technical solutions
* Implement new functionalities, enhancements, and process improvements
* Organize and deliver user training sessions to enhance application utilization and operational efficiency

**REQUIRED COMPETENCIES & QUALIFICATIONSCore Technical Skills (Required)**

* **SQL Server: Database operations, T-SQL query expertise, performance optimization**
* **Application Support: End-to-end technical troubleshooting and production issue resolution**
* IIS Management: Website configuration, site binding, and application pool administration
* Microsoft Office: Advanced proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint for documentation
* API Integration: Postman, Swagger, JSON validation, and API testing expertise

**Functional Skills (Required)**

* Process knowledge on Procure to Pay cycle
* SAP ERP knowledge as end user/Functional consultant
* Knowledge on Vendor management

**Professional & Behavioural Competencies**

* Incident Management: Ability to manage multiple high-priority incidents simultaneously while maintaining SLA commitments
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with focus on root-cause analysis and preventive solutions
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Effective communication with development, testing, and business stakeholders
* Attention to Detail: Commitment to data accuracy, quality assurance, and documentation standards
* Time Management: Ability to prioritize competing demands and deliver consistent results under pressure
* Communication Skills: Clear and effective communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Continuous Learning: Proactive approach to upskilling with evolving technologies and application modules

Interested candidates kindly share your updated resume to **Hiring@ramrajcotton.net**

Pay: From ₹300,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.  
  
**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation**

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS**

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.  
  
**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**  
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.

Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.

External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED**  
**Financial Accountability**

Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation  
**Supervision**

Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.

  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

title: SFDC Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce Solution Architect** with 10+ years of experience to lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise Salesforce solutions supporting global B2B and B2C business operations.The ideal candidate will combine strong solution architecture capabilities with hands-on Salesforce technical expertise. The role requires someone who can translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, guide development teams, make sound architectural decisions, and write or debug code when required.The architect will work across multiple Salesforce applications, external enterprise systems, country-specific business processes, and cross-functional technology teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and long-term business objectives.**Key Responsibilities1. Solution Architecture and Design**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, from requirements discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce architectures, technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Evaluate standard Salesforce capabilities, configuration, declarative automation, custom development, and external services to recommend the most appropriate solution.
* Define architectural standards, reusable components, coding guidelines, design patterns, and technical best practices.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing applications, integrations, business processes, and future enhancements.
* Identify technical risks, scalability constraints, platform limitations, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. Hands-on Salesforce Development**

* Write, review, debug, and optimize Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and other Salesforce customizations when required.
* Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes to validate architectural decisions and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of Apex triggers, asynchronous processing, Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, platform events, transaction management, and governor limits.
* Ensure code follows bulkification, security, exception-handling, testability, and performance best practices.
* Review complex implementations and guide developers in resolving technical issues.
* Participate directly in critical development activities, production troubleshooting, and performance optimization when necessary.

**3. Salesforce Data Modeling and Governance**

* Design scalable Salesforce data models using standard and custom objects, appropriate relationships, and well-defined ownership and sharing strategies.
* Define data mastership, external identifiers, deduplication, matching, data migration, and reconciliation approaches.
* Design data models that support global customer identities, B2B relationships, B2C customer journeys, and country-specific business requirements.
* Ensure appropriate data access, privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into the architecture.

**4. Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms such as SAP, customer portals, identity providers, middleware, and marketing platforms.
* Define suitable integration patterns using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and middleware where appropriate.
* Address authentication, authorization, idempotency, retries, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and integration resilience.
* Collaborate with enterprise integration and platform teams to manage dependencies, API contracts, release sequencing, and system-wide changes.

**5. Global Platform and Release Governance**

* Support a global Salesforce platform operating across multiple countries and business markets.
* Balance global architecture standards with legitimate local business and regulatory requirements.
* Evaluate the impact of changes across countries, applications, integrations, and downstream systems before approving designs.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, development teams, QA, DevOps, security, and platform teams to ensure controlled delivery.
* Contribute to release planning, technical risk assessments, environment strategy, deployment readiness, and production stability.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and architectural fragmentation across markets.

**6. Technical Leadership and Team Enablement**

* Provide technical direction and architectural guidance to Salesforce developers, technical leads, QA engineers, and integration teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design walkthroughs, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Establish development standards and reusable patterns that improve code quality, maintainability, and developer productivity.
* Mentor team members and support technical decision-making across distributed teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**7. Platform Evolution and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical fit, and platform strategy.
* Identify opportunities to improve performance, reduce technical debt, simplify integrations, and optimize delivery costs.
* Contribute to Salesforce platform roadmaps and long-term architecture decisions.
* Support production incident analysis and implement sustainable solutions that prevent recurring issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Hands-on experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce security, and declarative automation.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and visibility, governor limits, transaction boundaries, and platform architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and asynchronous or event-driven patterns.
* Understanding of integration resilience, error handling, monitoring, data reconciliation, and API security.
* Experience with Salesforce deployments, source control, CI/CD, and release management.
* Familiarity with enterprise identity and access management, SSO, OAuth, and external identity solutions.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues and validate architectural decisions through working code or prototypes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and customer engagement integrations.
* Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP integrations.
* Experience with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with multi-country Salesforce implementations and global platform governance.
* Experience with Experience Cloud portals, external users, customer identity, and large-scale customer data management.
* Familiarity with consent management, customer data privacy, and market-specific regulatory requirements.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Typically 10+ years of Salesforce or relevant enterprise CRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience owning solution architecture for complex Salesforce implementations.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and collaborating across business and technology functions.
* Salesforce Application Architect certification preferred; System Architect or relevant advanced certifications are an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

**Success Criteria**The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Deliver scalable and maintainable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
* Make defensible design decisions with clear consideration of alternatives, risks, and trade-offs.
* Independently validate critical technical designs through code, prototypes, debugging, and code reviews.
* Minimize regression risk across existing systems, integrations, and country implementations.
* Improve engineering standards and enable development teams to deliver consistently.
* Maintain a balance between architectural leadership and hands-on technical contribution.

**Role Expectation**This is an architecture-led role with hands-on technical responsibilities. The candidate is not expected to spend every day implementing features, but must be capable of independently writing and debugging Apex and related Salesforce code when complex technical challenges, critical issues, or architectural validation require it.

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Data Engineer – Ruah Tech Solutions (Embedded with Impact Investment Platform)
description:
**Role summary**

As a Data Engineer, you will be employed by Ruah Tech Solutions and embedded into a next-generation decentralised impact investment platform, helping to design, build, and scale data infrastructure for an ESG and impact-focused product with an automation-first and AI-assisted approach. You will create robust pipelines to ingest, transform, and activate raw ESG, transaction, blockchain, and IoT data into strategic insights that power transparency, decision-making, and ML/AI applications.

**About the platform (client)**

Our client is a decentralised impact investment firm that transforms overlooked real-world assets into shared prosperity for communities around the world. By securing and tokenising assets such as land, water, timber, agriculture, and other commodities, they create transparent, blockchain-enabled governance models that keep financial sovereignty in the hands of local stakeholders while opening access to retail, institutional, and community investors. Built on institutional-grade compliance and on-chain accountability, their platform uses a governance token to connect capital with high-impact projects across emerging markets, aligning long-term economic growth with measurable social and environmental outcomes.

**About the engagement**

You will operate as part of an Embedded Capability Team that moves in lockstep with the client’s internal rhythms, working as a true extension of their in-house team rather than a separate vendor track. The engagement is designed for long-term capability building, shared ownership of outcomes, and deep domain expertise in sustainability, impact, and financial data over time.

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines for ingesting raw ESG, transaction, blockchain, and IoT data from diverse sources including sensors, on-chain events, and off-chain APIs.
* Transform and enrich datasets to fuel analytics, reporting, ML/AI models, and dashboards that demonstrate platform impact and compliance.
* Implement data storage solutions (data lakes, warehouses, vector databases) optimized for performance, cost, and query efficiency in cloud environments supporting ML workloads.
* Collaborate with full-stack, Web3, and platform engineers to integrate data flows into product features, AI applications, dashboards, and governance tools.
* Apply automation-first practices including orchestrated ETL/ELT pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and AI-assisted data quality monitoring to ensure reliability and velocity.
* Establish data security and governance frameworks (e.g., access controls, encryption, lineage tracking, compliance with standards like ISO 27001).
* Participate fully in the client’s agile cadences (planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and internal rhythms, ensuring tight alignment and clear communication.
* Proactively optimize data systems for scale, cost, and performance while identifying opportunities to leverage AI/ML for anomaly detection, predictive insights, and ESG impact forecasting.

**Required skills and experience**

* Strong experience building production data pipelines with tools like Apache Airflow, dbt, Kafka, or similar orchestration frameworks.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python (or similar) for data transformation, with familiarity in cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Experience with data modelling, warehousing, and handling semi-structured data from sources like JSON, blockchain events, APIs, and IoT streams.
* Familiarity with cloud-native development, containerization, and CI/CD for data infrastructure.
* Practical experience with data security fundamentals (e.g., encryption at rest/transit, row/column-level security, auditing).
* Proven experience in product-oriented data teams, collaborating with engineers and stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
* Typically 3–5+ years of relevant data engineering experience, or equivalent capability demonstrated through portfolio and prior roles.

**Preferred skills**

* Proficiency with ML/AI applications and infrastructure (e.g., feature stores, model serving, vector databases like Pinecone, MLflow).
* Experience processing blockchain/Web3 data (e.g., on-chain transactions, token metadata, DeFi protocols) and IoT sensor data for ESG monitoring.
* Hands-on with ESG, financial, or impact datasets, including metrics for social/environmental outcomes derived from real-world IoT instrumentation.
* Advanced automation and AI tooling (e.g., AI-driven data validation, automated schema evolution, MLOps pipelines).
* Knowledge of streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, Flink), microservices data patterns, and security-by-design (e.g., SAST for data pipelines).
* Familiarity with AWS services (e.g., Glue, Lambda, S3, SageMaker) and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform).
* Comfort working across time zones and cultures, with clear written and verbal communication.

**How we work**

You will join a team that values curiosity, thoughtful craftsmanship, and mutual support, where engineers are encouraged to take ownership of both their own growth and the outcomes they deliver. The role suits someone who is energized by collaborative problem-solving, cares about the real-world impact of the products they build, and is willing to invest in long-term relationships with both Ruah Tech Solutions and the client’s product and engineering teams.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong portfolio of data projects demonstrating pipeline ownership and impact delivery.

**What we offer**

* The opportunity to work on meaningful, impact-driven technology that connects finance, data, IoT, and communities.
* An embedded engagement model that allows you to build deep product and domain expertise while benefiting from Ruah Tech Solutions’ support structure and community of practitioners.
* A learning-oriented environment with space for experimentation, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration across product, data, infrastructure, Web3, and AI/ML domains.

title: Lead Digital Architect
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

JOB DUTIES:

Seeking a highly skilled and visionary Data Architect to work with highly skilled engineers to build a robust next gen data platform. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical and functional expertise in Big Data, Data Warehousing, and end-to-end real-time data movement. You will architect and build Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital platform, while driving innovation in AI and advanced analytics.

* Competent to perform all programming and provide oversight for architecture assessment and design for development assignments without close supervision; normally assigned the more complex aspects of systems work.
* Lead Architecture design of end-to-end enterprise integrations that serves multiple business functions.
* Design and implement end-to-end near real-time data movement solutions that provide core capabilities for the enterprise.
* Define the overall data architecture strategy aligned with business goals.
* Establish data governance policies, standards, and compliance Drives application development focused around delivering business valuable features
* Maintains high standards of software quality within the team by establishing good practices and security guardrails per Enterprise standards.
* Knowledge of target architecture; ability to develop the IT blueprint and roadmap while aligning the architecture and processes with business strategies and objectives
* Develop and maintain current, planned, and future state architecture blueprints. Lead in the identification and analysis of enterprise business drivers and requirements that drive the future state architecture.
* Work with business analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders. Translate business requirements into technical data solutions
* Communicate with end users and stake holders to help direct development, debugging, and testing of application software for accuracy, integrity, interoperability, and completeness.
* Performs integrated testing and customer acceptance testing of components that requires careful planning and execution to ensure timely, quality results.

Typical customers include Caterpillar customers, dealers, other external companies who purchase services offered by Caterpillar as well as internal business unit and/or service centre groups. The position is challenged to quickly and correctly identify problems that may not be obvious. The incumbent solves problems by determining the best architecture, within departmental guidelines, from many existing solutions.

Basic qualifications:

* Four-year bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a Computer Science or Information Technology, or related field
* 12+ years or more of software development experience or at least 3 years of architecture experience with strong demonstrable experience.

* 5+ years or more of experience in designing conceptual, logical, and physical data models & data models support scalability, performance, and integration needs.
* 5+ years of Data Warehousing experience & optimizing database performance, indexing, and storage strategies
* Expert in implementing security measures for data at rest and in transit and defining access control, encryption, and compliance frameworks
* Strong in designing data integration solutions across systems ensuring smooth data flow between applications, APIs, and data warehouses

* Top candidates will also have proven experience in many of the following,

* Designing, developing, deploying and maintaining software at scale, with good understanding of concurrency.
* Working experience in Python as an Object-Oriented programming language
* In-Depth understanding of how Data pipelines work in Big Data & expert in designing architectures for cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure) for large-scale processing.
* Expertise and experience in building Large Data Lakes and Data Warehouse (Snowflake Preferred).
* Expertise in building end-to-end near real-time data pipelines for OLTP & OLAP.
* Strong architecture exposure for building robust Data Platforms
* Expertise in SQL and NO-SQL databases, Message brokers and other AWS services such as Kafka/Kinesis, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora, AWS RDS PostgreSQL.
* Test driven development and behaviour driven development.
* Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints.
* Passion for technology and an eagerness to contribute to a team-oriented environment.
* Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities.
* Strong understanding of AI concepts and latest developments (Gen AI, MCP, ATA, etc.).

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO).

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Relocation is available for this position.

October 26, 2026 - November 5, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: MS Fabric Sr. Architect
description:
**Job Summary**

Senior Architect role in a multinational organization focused on building scalable data and analytics solutions using Python LakeHouse platforms Spark Job Definition OneLake SQL and PySpark. The role requires deep expertise in retail banking data and processes delivering secure and performant hybrid cloud data architectures that drive business value in a hybrid work model with day shift.

description:

We are seeking a **Lead/Senior Security System Engineer** to design, implement, and operate secure, compliant network segmentation between regional environments and Global networks, using a standardised control stack of Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Cloudflare for DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application protection. This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons

title: Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

The Test Analyst will design execute and manage functional and integration tests for payer domain systems built on Facets ensuring reliable claim processing and member services. The role involves developing test strategies managing defects end to end and collaborating in a hybrid work model during day shifts to enhance product quality and reduce production incidents for global healthcare operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop comprehensive test plans and reusable test cases for payer domain workflows in Facets ensuring robust coverage of enrollment claims adjudication billing and provider management scenarios to support high quality system releases.
* Execute functional integration and regression test cycles for Facets based payer platforms validating core payer processes and capturing detailed evidence to enable transparent quality reporting to project stakeholders.
* Perform thorough defect management activities by logging classifying and tracking issues across their lifecycle ensuring accurate root cause details and timely closure that help reduce recurring production problems.
* Collaborate with business analysts and configuration teams to refine testable requirements for payer systems ensuring clear acceptance criteria and minimizing gaps between business expectations and delivered functionality.
* Create and maintain structured test data sets aligned to payer domain needs including member provider and claim records to simulate realistic business operations and improve reliability of test outcomes.
* Conduct impact analysis on change requests and system updates in Facets determining affected modules and defining targeted regression suites that optimize effort while safeguarding critical business functions.
* Use test management tools to plan sprints track execution progress and provide status dashboards enabling effective coordination across hybrid teams working in day shifts and supporting predictable delivery timelines.
* Review test results and defect trends to identify quality risks contributing clear insights that guide prioritization of fixes and preventive actions for payer products and services.
* Partner with development and configuration engineers to replicate issues clarify expected behavior and validate fixes ensuring that defect resolutions address underlying business scenarios rather than only surface symptoms.
* Document test artifacts including plans cases traceability matrices and closure reports in a structured manner supporting audit readiness and knowledge transfer across global teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes by proposing enhancements in test strategy automation readiness and standards for Facets based payer implementations.
* Align testing activities with organizational quality objectives helping the company deliver stable payer platforms that improve member experiences and operational efficiency across healthcare ecosystems.
* Support hybrid work practices by maintaining clear communication organized documentation and reliable status updates enabling seamless collaboration without the need for travel.

**Qualifications**

* Bring proven experience in test and defect management demonstrating ability to own test cycles end to end and maintain accurate defect repositories that guide decision making for releases.
* Apply strong skills in test strategy development by defining scope approach and risk based prioritization for complex payer implementations ensuring efficient use of testing effort.
* Utilize practical expertise in Facets configuration and processing flows to design meaningful test scenarios that mirror real world payer operations and regulatory nuances.
* Leverage deep understanding of payer domain concepts such as benefits authorizations claims capitation and provider networks to validate system behavior against industry expectations.
* Demonstrate proficiency in using enterprise test management tools and defect tracking platforms enabling structured planning execution and reporting in hybrid delivery models.
* Show capability to interpret functional specifications and mapping documents transforming them into clear test cases that reduce ambiguity and improve requirement traceability.
* Prefer exposure to related healthcare technologies and data standards that interact with Facets supporting broader integration testing and smoother collaboration with interface teams.

title: Senior Specialist - Embedded Testing
description:

Responsible for Handling an Embedded Testing Team across Protection & Controls product lines and responsible for planning, designing, developing, and executing comprehensive test strategies to ensure the delivery of high‑quality products. description:

We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services

* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables:**

The incumbent will be accountable for the comprehensive management and delivery of projects related to their specific commodity within the tractor parts development domain. This pivotal role ensures seamless execution aligned with strategic objectives and quality standards.

* **Project Management and Coordination:**
    
  Take ownership of the end-to-end project lifecycle including initial technical sign off, synthesis of competitive quotations, and rigorous adherence to project milestones and timelines. Engage actively in feasibility studies, risk assessments, and provide recommendations to guarantee project viability and success.
* **Cost, Quality, and Delivery (QCD):**
    
  Meet established material cost targets while maintaining strict budgetary discipline. Ensure that all deliverables meet or exceed quality standards, focusing on manufacturability, tooling feasibility, and supplier capabilities to consistently fulfill QCD commitments.
* **Process Compliance & Governance:**
    
  Oversee the implementation of Manufacturing Process Development System (MPDS) gateways, ensuring compliance with Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) and Part Submission Warrant (PSW) requirements. Collaborate closely with Centres of Excellence (COEs) to uphold regulatory, safety, and quality compliance standards.
* **Capacity & Volume Planning:**
    
  Analyze production capacity against forecasted volumes to prevent bottlenecks, working alongside design teams to facilitate first-time-right delivery. Ensure scalability of processes and readiness for volume ramp-up phases.
* **Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics:**
    
  Develop, maintain and interpret Management Information System (MIS) reports reflecting project progress, key issues like High Impact Hourly Rate (HIHR), Material Inspection Material Rejection (MIMR), and Low Incoming Lot Rejection (LILR). Use these insights to drive continuous improvement.
* **Support & Collaboration:**
    
  Engage and coordinate with Home Commodity teams for technical and delivery support. Act as a liaison with COEs for technical sign-offs, ensuring stakeholder alignment and transparent communication.
* **Decision-making and Escalation:**
    
  Apply discernment in escalating critical issues to Senior Leadership, such as delayed Statement of Requirements (SOR), part development delays impacting bottlenecks, or Engineering Change Notice (ECN) discrepancies involving design and procurement teams.

This role necessitates a proactive approach with effective cross-functional collaboration, ensuring project objectives are met on schedule, within budget, and at the highest quality standards.

**Experience**
--------------

**Experience:**

Applicants should possess between 7 to 10 years of relevant professional experience in tractor parts development or related automotive sectors. Experience must include significant exposure to project management and the execution of complex technical projects within a manufacturing environment.

Preferred experience encompasses the following:

* Leading cross-functional teams through the complete product development cycle, with demonstrated success managing timelines, costs, and quality targets.
* Hands-on involvement with proprietary mechanical components as well as the electrical and electronic systems specific to agricultural machinery.
* Experience in supplier evaluation, tooling feasibility assessments, and vendor management.
* Proficiency in interpreting technical documents such as Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), technical drawings, and Process Control Plans.
* Track record in implementing and monitoring manufacturing processes aligned with MPDS guidelines.

Exposure to use of advanced data management tools such as SAP for material resource planning and procurement, together with proficiency in Microsoft Excel for robust data analysis, will be highly advantageous.

**Industry Preferred**
----------------------

**Industry Preferred:**

Expertise within the agricultural machinery and tractor manufacturing industry is strongly preferred. Experience within companies specialising in tractor design, development, and production will provide a solid foundation for success in this role.

Preferred industry sectors include but are not limited to:

* Tractor and agricultural equipment manufacturing
* Agricultural parts suppliers specialising in mechanical and electronic components
* OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers serving the farm machinery market
* Heavy engineering companies involved in outdoor equipment manufacturing.

Familiarity with industry regulations, standards, and emerging trends in tractor engineering and sustainability will be considered highly valuable.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Qualifications:**

A strong educational background is essential, with a minimum requirement of a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or Bachelor of Engineering (BE) degree obtained through a regular full-time program in a relevant engineering discipline.

The ideal fields of study include:

* Mechanical Engineering
* Automotive Engineering
* Electrical or Electronics Engineering (preferably with coursework or experience related to tractor systems)
* Production or Industrial Engineering with a focus on manufacturing systems.

Additional professional certifications in project management, quality assurance, and supply chain management will be beneficial to support knowledge and performance in the role.

Continual professional development and participation in industry forums or workshops related to tractor engineering and parts development are encouraged.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

**General Requirements:**

The successful candidate will demonstrate a blend of technical expertise, project leadership, and excellent interpersonal skills. Key competencies include:

* **Technical Proficiency:** Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel for comprehensive data analysis and reporting are required. Working knowledge or experience with SAP software is highly preferred to efficiently manage procurement and resource planning.
* **Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:** Strong analytical capabilities to interpret complex technical and production data and provide actionable solutions. Ability to perform root cause analysis and implement effective corrective actions promptly.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential to communicate complex technical information effectively across multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
* **Collaboration & Leadership:** Capability to work collaboratively within diverse teams and lead cross-functional initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing teams and driving them towards common project goals.
* **Tractor Parts Development Knowledge:** A deep understanding of both proprietary mechanical components and electrical/electronic commodities used in tractors, including design, development, testing, and quality assurance.
* **Project Management and Execution:** Proven ability to manage complex projects with strict deadlines and budget considerations, including meticulous scheduling and resource allocation.
* **Compliance and Standards Adherence:** Comprehensive knowledge of industry safety, regulatory, and quality standards with a commitment to uphold them throughout project phases.
* **Innovation Mindset:** Enthusiastic about driving process improvements and implementing innovative technology solutions to enhance product performance and development efficiency.

Travel is not required for this position, allowing focus on onsite leadership and collaboration within the Product Development division.

We strive to ensure equitable opportunities for all candidates and employees irrespective of their background, age, ethnicity, gender identity, disability status, or any other dimension of diversity. description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

We are looking for a highly skilled **Engineer III, AI Science** to design, build, and scale our next generation of AI systems. In this senior technical role, you will be a key driver in transitioning our machine learning capabilities from traditional predictive modeling to advanced Agentic and Prescriptive AI paradigms.

You will be hands-on in developing autonomous AI agents, large language model (LLM) pipelines, and reinforcement learning engines that optimize customer lifecycles, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business value. You will also serve as a technical lead on high-impact projects, mentoring junior engineers and shaping our internal AI engineering standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Agentic AI & LLM Development**

* Design, build, and deploy multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows using modern frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI).
* Develop robust LLM-based applications capable of reasoning, tool-use, and executing complex, multi-step tasks for dynamic customer interactions and internal automation.
* Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge), and prompt-engineering best practices to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant agent behavior in production.

**2. Predictive & Prescriptive Modeling**

* Build state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence models, tree-based models) for forecasting customer behavior, churn, propensity, and lifetime value (CLTV).
* Develop prescriptive optimization engines using Reinforcement Learning (RL), Contextual Bandits, or mathematical optimization to power real-time "Next Best Action" (NBA) and dynamic pricing recommendations.
* Apply causal inference and uplift modeling techniques to measure and optimize the true incremental impact of AI-driven interventions.

**3. Production Engineering & MLOps**

* Collaborate with MLOps and Data Engineering teams to deploy machine learning and agentic models into highly scalable, low-latency production environments.
* Write production-grade, optimized code (Python) and build robust API endpoints for AI service integration.
* Design and maintain telemetry for monitoring model drift, agent hallucination rates, and overall system performance.

**4. Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead the end-to-end technical execution of complex AI projects, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
* Mentor Engineer I and II team members, conduct rigorous code/model reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 5+ years of applied industry experience in machine learning, AI science, or data engineering (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).
* **Technical Skills:**Advanced proficiency in **Python** and standard ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost/LightGBM).Hands-on experience building and deploying **LLMs and Agentic AI** (LangChain, OpenAI APIs, open-source models like Llama 3/Mistral, RAG architectures).Strong foundation in **Predictive and Prescriptive ML** methodologies (time-series, reinforcement learning, optimization algorithms).Solid SQL skills and experience with big data processing (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake).
* **Engineering Best Practices:** Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for ML.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience building AI engines specifically for Base Management, Marketing Tech, or Customer Value Management (CVM).
* Experience with Causal Machine Learning (DoWhy, EconML).
* Active contributor to open-source AI projects or a portfolio demonstrating complex agentic workflow development.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

Real‑Time Systems Integration

title: Engineering - Systems Analyst
description:
**About Us:**

  
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.  
  

**Job Description:**

**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.

What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.

**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.

* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.

* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.

* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.

If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.

**Position Description:**

Under general direction, the Engineering Systems Analyst drives strategies to improve engineering processes and ensure systems and tools are efficient and optimized. The individual will provide functional and technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements while directly supporting engineering initiatives from the business. They will assist in designing the structure of our engineering systems and carry out programs to ensure the proper architecture is implemented. Provide hands-on experience in software development and be able to manage complex programs. They will also assist in designing, building, and updating database structures and SQL queries. You will then deploy engineering solutions assuring its implementation, effectiveness, adaptability, responsiveness, quality, governance, and the continuous improvement. This role is responsible for providing technical assistance to other engineers. This role also frequently provides guidance to engineering staff, using extensive experience to manage the prioritization, development and completion of technology projects.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**

* Maintain and administer PDM and CAD systems, databases, and infrastructure. Optimize systems for efficiency and security.

* Partner with users to understand PDM, CAD, and drafting concerns, troubleshoot issues, and propose process improvements to increase user efficiency and experience.

* Troubleshoot PDM and CAD issues with the end user base. Perform root cause analysis to develop, test, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.

* Develop and deliver training for PDM and CAD products. Establish and communicate PDM and CAD best practices. Standardize PDM and CAD environments across all workstations.

* Work with IT to develop and support communication protocols between PDM and other data systems as required.

* Manage licenses for PDM and CAD software and add-ons.

* Evaluate, maintain, and develop new tools to support the end user base.

* Evaluate operating systems and upgrades to manage impact on CAD servers and workstations

* Attends and participates, as an ‘ambassador’ for testing, in project meetings regarding solution of the requirements, design, and test plan review.

* Maintain a working knowledge of advancing technologies. Identify applicable solutions and implement with existing networks when appropriate.

* Identify creative ways to reduce cost by streamlining processes and systems (i.e. modification of responsibilities, consolidation or tasks, elimination of non-value added processes and re-engineering processes and systems).

* Drive continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management leveraging PowerBI and other similar tools.

* Participate in blueprinting and mapping sessions with customers for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations.

* Analyze requirements and contribute to the design of CAD/PDM solutions to complex requirements

* Design and execute implementations for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations

* Mentor and collaborate with services team members on design, documentation, and implementations

* SQL queries and analysis

* Participate in large project support, system/application implementations and upgrades.

* Assist with the long term migration to standard engineering tools.

* Designing and maintaining custom applications.

* Collaborate with DBAs and Infrastructure teams.

**Job Specifications:**

* Extensive knowledge and experience in Engineering PDM and CAD applications including SolidWorks and Autodesk products

* Broad understanding of the engineering new product development process and how CAD and PDM/PLM play a role within that process.

* Excellent team player.

* Strong logic, problem solving ability, takes initiative.

* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, IT, or related technical field required

* Typically has 4+ years’ engineering or IT experience

* BlueStar PLM experience preferred

**Supervisory/Responsibility:**

* Indicate if individual contributor w/no direct reports or if supervise direct reports & level of reports (individual contributors, supervisors, managers, etc.)

**Work Environment:**

Works in an office environment but may occasionally be exposed to manufacturing conditions to include noise, fumes, Odors, gases, dust, and hazards such as moving mechanical and electrical machinery. Required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided to mitigate or eliminate these hazards and all employees will be trained on appropriate use of PPE.

**Position Type:**

This is a regular, full-time position with the understanding that a regular workweek will require extended days and hours as needed to meet business needs.

No travel is expected for this position

OFFICE

Performing the role frequently uses close vision, speech, hearing, and dexterity to operate office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.

description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

**Job Summary**

About Comcast Next Generation Access Networks (NGAN) NGAN (Next Gen Access Networks) is a group within Headquarters at Comcast that partners with all three divisional Engineering & Technical Operations teams to drive expansion, new technologies and continuous improvement into the ‘last mile’ of the network.

**Job Description**

**Job Description**
-------------------

Are you passionate about digital media, entertainment, and access technologies? Do you like big challenges and working within a highly motivated team environment?

The Next Gen Access Technologies team is a small and fast-moving team of world-class experts who are innovating in end-to-end IP services delivery. As a senior integration engineer on the next gen access team, you will design and develop software orchestration solutions used in our new product testing lab to verify the technology that will enable next generation services to our customers. We are a team that thrives on big challenges, results, quality, and agility.

**Who does the Next Gen Access Technologies team work with?**

The team manages new technology development and deployment programs that require coordination across multiple teams. There is a strong, collaborative relationship between Next Gen Access, developers, vendors, QA engineers, deployment and operations teams as partners in the delivery of quality systems and services. We work at all levels of the organization to plan and deliver new services and service capabilities.

**What are some interesting problems you’ll be working on?**

In this role, you will be part of a team that is responsible for the development of automated software suites that validate Comcast’s next generation access network capabilities in an R&D test lab environment. You will automate time-consuming manual test processes by orchestrating data flows from a variety of systems to build a “big picture” of the system state as it progresses though operational modes. In addition, you will work with the system engineers on developing applications for debugging and monitoring live systems in the field.

**Where can you make an impact?**

You’ll be working with the best and brightest minds in Comcast to verify the access networks infrastructure and products that will power the next generation of services. Success in this role is characterized by a higher speed to market as well as fewer customer-facing defects and outages of equipment and services that delight and entertain our customers.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop solutions to convert manual data-gathering processes across multiple systems and devices to fully automated, reliable software tools
* Develop tools to integrate parallel data streams from a variety of APIs, tools, logs, and systems into a cohesive unit using a variety of technologies.
* Develop tools to orchestrate device interactions on multiple systems.
* Develop tools to assist the system engineers in debugging and monitoring systems in the field.
* Work collaboratively on a small development team.
* Be available for live meetings with USA-based team members, usually in the evening, local time.
* Participate with fellow team members and the test leads during the automation design phase.
* Support the lab test team in the execution of automated tools you develop.

**Skills & Requirements**
-------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or equivalent work experience.
* 6-8 years of software development.
* Strong preference for experience with business process automation, EIA, and other software orchestration technologies and Python based automation frameworks.
* Strong preference for experience with asynchronous programming
* Experience with front-end system development like React
* Experience with regular expressions and predictive text data processing
* Experience with cable network architecture, specification, engineering, validation a plus.
* Experience with AI Agent, Skill, MCP is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Keen attention to detail and high level of commitment.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

Bachelor's Degree

While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.

5-7 Years

The Machine Subsystem team works on Embedded Control Systems for various Caterpillar Machines. This job involves designing, developing and testing control system features for Caterpillar products.
